headline: 719 dead as measles outbreak kills another child in 24 hours
summary: The Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS) reports a growing toll with over 100,000 people showing symptoms since mid-March.
details: Another child has died within 24 hours showing symptoms of measles, bringing the total death toll to 719 since March 15, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).
The DGHS report released on July 1 indicates that 626 people died with measles symptoms and 93 were confirmed measles deaths.
In the last 24 hours alone, 951 people exhibited symptoms of the disease, while 167 new cases of confirmed measles were identified.
Since March 15, a total of 102,028 people have shown symptoms, and 12,132 have been confirmed as measles patients.
Hospitalizations have been high, with 85,509 people admitted to hospitals over the last three and a half months.
Of those admitted, 81,882 patients have recovered and been discharged from the hospitals.
caption:
719 deaths and over 100,000 symptomatic cases. The measles outbreak continues to claim lives in Bangladesh.

Another child has died within 24 hours showing symptoms of measles, bringing the total death toll to 719 since March 15, according to the Directorate General of Health Services (DGHS).

The DGHS report released on July 1 indicates that 626 people died with measles symptoms and 93 were confirmed measles deaths.

In the last 24 hours alone, 951 people exhibited symptoms of the disease, while 167 new cases of confirmed measles were identified.

Since March 15, a total of 102,028 people have shown symptoms, and 12,132 have been confirmed as measles patients.

Hospitalizations have been high, with 85,509 people admitted to hospitals over the last three and a half months.

Of those admitted, 81,882 patients have recovered and been discharged from the hospitals.

#Bangladesh #HealthCrisis #MeaslesOutbreak #DGHS #PublicHealth #News

Source: Jamuna TV, Somoy News
